items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I was playing tenor and Bird was playing third. And they had a -- what do you call it? Juggler.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then that became a famous solo amongst the musicians, like Coleman Hawkins brought in Soul "Became" at that time. In fact, we did it on there the other day. And even Charlie Parker and all of them years later copied that solo, you know.

So then I played -- I stayed with Cab up until 19 -- well, say Christmas of 1935. And we used to play 50 weeks of theaters, right straight across the board from New York to California every year. And then -- well, I'll say 40 weeks
